Assistant ProfessorB.Com (Bangalore University), M.Com (Bangalore University), Ph.D. (Tumkur University) Linkedin Link She is an Assistant Professor with over 8.7 years of teaching experience. She holds a Ph.D. in Commerce with a specialisation in Marketing. An accomplished academician, she has authored a book on Strategic Management and has published several research papers in reputed journals, focusing on areas such as social media marketing, consumer behaviour and business strategies. She is dedicated to fostering a dynamic learning environment and guiding students toward academic excellence.
